definitions.explanation: An imaginary horizontal line on the earth's surface, running east-west, marking degrees of latitude from the equator.

examples.english: To draw lines of latitude on a map.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤道|せきどう}→赤道：04358_sekidou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緯度|いど}→緯度：03978_ido⟧⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緯線|いせん}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The equator is the line of latitude at zero degrees.

examples.japanese: {北緯|ほくい}38⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緯線|いせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朝鮮半島|ちょうせんはんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軍事境界線|ぐんじきょうかいせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目安|めやす}→目安：00276_meyasu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: The 38th parallel north is known as a rough marker for the military demarcation line on the Korean Peninsula.

notes:
A geography term composed of {緯|い} (latitude) and ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line). Lines of latitude run horizontally (east-west) around the globe, in contrast to ⟦{経線|けいせん}→経線：26002_keisen⟧ (lines of longitude), which run vertically (north-south).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緯線|いせん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{経線|けいせん}→経線：26002_keisen⟧ — latitude and longitude lines
- {北緯|ほくい}〜⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緯線|いせん} — the latitude line at 〜 degrees north
- {緯線|いせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧ — along the line of latitude

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{経線|けいせん}→経線：26002_keisen⟧ — line of longitude; meridian
- ⟦{緯度|いど}→緯度：03978_ido⟧ — latitude (the measurement itself)
- ⟦{赤道|せきどう}→赤道：04358_sekidou⟧ — equator (the zero-degree latitude line)
